reviews.author: Manuel Lopez Barrientos
reviews.text: Outstanding service from Kevin and his team! They performed a magnificent high-altitude tree pruning at a very fair price, leaving everything immaculate and thoroughly tidied. We will trust all our future work to this great company!

reviews.author: Annette Svensson
reviews.text: We hired Sexigarden to clean and prune 5 tall palm trees. They did an excellent job, fast, cleaned up and took away all the palm fronds and debris. We are very pleased with their work and friendly approach. We highly recommend them. /Annette

reviews.author: Jose Antonio Garcia
reviews.text: Kevin and Michael did the high pruning on our palm. Super friendly, professional, fast, and efficient—the way things should be done. Highly recommended!

faqs.question: Is the initial quote and technical site visit free of charge?
faqs.answer: Yes, completely free with zero obligation. We visit your villa, garden, or community across Almuñécar, La Herradura, Salobreña, or Motril to take precise measurements and prepare a tailored estimate.

faqs.question: How long does artificial grass installation or landscaping take?
faqs.answer: For medium-sized projects (40 - 80 m²), artificial grass installation is typically completed in 2 to 3 working days. Full outdoor refurbishments including masonry and pool coping take between 1 and 3 weeks depending on project scope.

faqs.question: What warranty do you provide on materials and workmanship?
faqs.answer: Our high-grade artificial turf comes with up to 8 years manufacturer warranty against UV degradation and color fading. All structural masonry, waterproofing, and paving works carry full legal craftsmanship guarantees.

faqs.question: What are your payment terms?
faqs.answer: We establish a transparent milestone-based payment schedule: a deposit upon contract confirmation and material procurement, partial payments matching project progress, and final balance after your full inspection and satisfaction.
